messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer needs the ability to define a custom claim-reference format to match their internal naming conventions and prevent data mismatches.
  quote: We really need to set up a custom claim-reference format because our internal systems use specific naming conventions and we can’t have mismatches when pulling reports or syncing with suppliers.

response.content: {"title": "Custom claim-reference format missing", "problem_statement": "Users cannot define custom claim-reference formats to match internal naming conventions. This causes data mismatches during report generation and supplier syncing."}
